## About
Zepco Speedometer Repair fixes the gauges on your dashboard: speedometers, tachometers and instrument clusters. We're on N Central Expy in Richardson, open weekdays.
Customers have brought us a Ford cluster, a Prius with a dashboard issue and a Hummer panel where not one gauge worked. One reviewer called us an honest and trustworthy shop, and another said the staff was very sweet.
If your speedometer is stuck or your gauges are dark, give us a call and tell us what's going on.

## Services
- Cluster repairs: Bring in your instrument cluster and we'll get it working again.
- Dashboard: When something on your dash stops working right, we track it down and fix it.
- Tachometer assessment: We take in tachometers for assessment, including mechanical farm tractor units.
